purpose: Provide one machine-readable view of open work so OPEN, ACTIVE, REVIEW_REQUESTED, REVIEW_PASSED, ACCEPTANCE_PENDING, PAUSED, SUPERSEDED and EXPIRED are not conflated.
authority_rule: This registry is a derived audit view. Exact PR heads, Git history, canonical state files and review receipts/comments remain the underlying evidence. It must not become a second canonical truth source.

state_vocabulary.ACTIVE: work may proceed within current gate
state_vocabulary.PAUSED: work preserved but must not execute scientific next steps
state_vocabulary.LAB_PASS: Lab review passed exact reviewed head; not equivalent to merge/acceptance
state_vocabulary.ACCEPTANCE_PENDING: review may have passed but canonical promotion/merge is not established
state_vocabulary.COLLECTION_CLOSED: time-bounded collection attempt ended and should not be resumed as if live
state_vocabulary.SUPERSEDED_CANDIDATE: later work or changed purpose likely makes this non-primary; closure decision still required
state_vocabulary.EXPIRED_CANDIDATE: time-specific purpose has passed; do not treat as active without explicit reauthorization
state_vocabulary.QUARANTINED: output exists but is not admitted for research decisions
state_vocabulary.UNKNOWN_REVIEW_REQUIRED: insufficient evidence was read during this audit to safely classify further
